role.uz: Python backend dasturchi va AI muhandis

bio.uz: Backend yozaman, unga AI ulayman va o'rganganlarimni shu yerda yozib boraman.
bio.en: I build backends, wire AI into them, and write down what I learn along the way.

about.uz: Qarshida yashayman. Django, DRF va FastAPI'da backend yozaman, loyihalarga Claude API va MCP orqali AI ulayman. Sfera IT Academy'da backend mentorman: Python, AI Engineering va olimpiadaga tayyorgarlik darslarini o'taman. Bo'sh vaqtimda o'z mahsulotlarimni quraman: Tester va Acadium.
about.en: I live in Qarshi, Uzbekistan. I write backends in Django, DRF and FastAPI and wire AI into products through the Claude API and MCP. I mentor backend students at Sfera IT Academy, teaching Python, AI engineering and olympiad prep. The rest of the time I build my own products: Tester and Acadium.
